observations: Photo 0 shows the interior of an oven with a single metal rack and a greenish tray or liner on the rack. The oven walls are dark and show signs of use or residue.

Photo 1 shows the top of a gas cooker with four burners arranged in two columns of two. The surface is stainless steel, showing wear and some discoloration. Each burner has a black metal grate and a central burner cap. There are four black control knobs visible at the front.

Photo 2 shows the full front view of the cooker. It has a brown front panel with four black control knobs and a black oven door with a handle. Below the oven door is a drawer with a red label that reads 'IDNIS' and 'Made in India'. The unit stands on four black feet.
The brand 'IDNIS' is visible on the front drawer in photo 2.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 clearly shows four burners on the cooktop. Photo 2 confirms the full unit with the cooktop and oven.

risks.risk: The gas burners may not ignite or function properly due to clogged ports or damaged components.
risks.proof: A video showing each burner lighting and burning steadily, or a close-up photo of the burner ports and igniters.

risks.risk: The oven may not heat properly or may have damaged heating elements or insulation.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven door closed and the interior light on, with the oven heating up (if possible) or a close-up of the heating elements.

risks.risk: The unit may have gas leaks, especially around the burners or connections.
risks.proof: A video showing a soapy water test applied to all gas connections and burners while the gas is turned on, to check for bubbles indicating leaks.

risks.risk: The control knobs may not operate correctly or may be misaligned with the burners.
risks.proof: A video showing each knob being turned and the corresponding burner responding.

proof_requests: Video showing each burner lighting and burning steadily.
Video showing the oven heating up or close-up of the heating elements.
Video of a soapy water test on all gas connections to check for leaks.
Video of each control knob being turned and the corresponding burner responding.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 4-burner gas cooker with oven by the brand IDNIS, but critical functional risks (burner operation, oven heating, gas leaks, knob functionality) cannot be assessed from the photos alone. These risks significantly affect value and safety, so proof of operation is required before pricing.
